source: Community consensus from rebornevo.com forum threads: in-game tier list (https://www.rebornevo.com/forums/topic/8518-pok%C3%A9mon-reborn-in-game-tier-list/), best early-game Pokemon (https://www.rebornevo.com/forums/topic/49187-best-pokemon-in-reborn-part-1-early-game/), top Pokemon in Reborn (https://www.rebornevo.com/forums/topic/29505-top-pokemon-in-reborn/), ultimate team thread (https://www.rebornevo.com/forums/topic/55487-whats-the-team-that-has-gotten-you-through-the-game-or-the-ultimate-team-for-reborn/), worth-the-wait thread (https://www.rebornevo.com/forums/topic/21070-which-pokemon-is-worth-the-wait/); remaining species rated by editorial reasoning on stats, abilities, and Reborn doubles/field context. Entries marked basis "community" follow forum consensus; "editorial" entries are judgment calls from stats, abilities and Reborn field effects.
